name: exploratory
description: Create data, charts, analytics, and reports in Exploratory Desktop v17 or later.

interface.longDescription:
Work in Exploratory Desktop on your computer from Codex: create and edit data frames, wrangling steps, charts, analytics, notes and dashboards in your local projects, including changes you have not published.

Requires Exploratory Desktop v17 or later, installed, signed in and running. In Desktop, open System Settings > MCP / CLI, turn on MCP, and choose Save. To let the AI create, change or delete content, also check Allow create, edit and delete; without it, the AI can only read. Desktop asks you before deletes, publishing and running R code unless you turn that off.

The plugin starts the exploratory-mcp command that Desktop puts on your PATH. Calls run in the app on your computer as the user signed in to Desktop. To read content published on exploratory.io, use the separate Exploratory Server plugin.
capabilities: Import data and edit data frames and wrangling steps in local Exploratory Desktop projects
Create and edit charts, analytics, notes and dashboards
Publish notes, dashboards and data frames to Exploratory Server when you ask
